translations.web: Flee sexual immorality! “Every sin that a man does is outside the body,” but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.
translations.bsb: Flee from sexual immorality. Every other sin a man can commit is outside his body, but he who sins sexually sins against his own body.
translations.kjv: Flee fornication. Every sin that a man doeth is without the body; but he that committeth fornication sinneth against his own body.
translations.asv: Flee fornication. Every sin that a man doeth is without the body; but he that committeth fornication sinneth against his own body.
